t: The first state to unite the Irrawaddy valley, ruled from Pagan, a walled city on the middle Irrawaddy dated by tradition to 849.
Its kings and subjects built some 10,000 Buddhist monuments on the plain of Bagan, and Theravada Buddhism became the faith of the realm.
Tax-free gifts of land to monasteries weakened the crown, and Mongol invasions in the 1280s broke the kingdom apart.
dyk: The Myazedi inscription of 1113 repeats the same text in Pali, Mon, Pyu and Old Burmese, and it became the key to deciphering the lost Pyu language.
ev: Traditional date for the fortification of Pagan
Anawrahta conquers the Mon city of Thaton, according to tradition
The four-language Myazedi inscription is set up
Mongol forces from Yunnan defeat Pagan at Ngasaunggyan
King Narathihapate is murdered as Yuan forces invade
The Myinsaing brothers depose Kyawswa, ending the dynasty
